shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && find .agents -type f && ls -la && cat AGENTS.md && git show --stat HEAD | head -50
cat package.json src/*.tsx tsconfig.json vite.config.ts index.html .gitignore; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; ls __agent_eval__; head -80 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md

rg -n -A 22 '^## (Navigation|Table)' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md | head -80; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -50
npm view @gravity-ui/navigation version peerDependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/table version peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @bem-react/classname lodash @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @dnd-kit/utilities 2>&1 | tail -5; npm ls @gravity-ui/icons @gravity-ui/i18n @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable 2>&1 | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/*/;

ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs 2>&1 | head; wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; rg -n '^#' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md
sed -n 1,124p node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md; ls -R node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs | head -40

f=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; wc -l $f; rg -n '^#|compact|menuItems|onItemClick|current|headerDecoration|hideCollapseButton|collapseTitle|logo|^\| `?(id|title|icon|tooltipText)' $f | head -100

f=node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n 309,365p $f; sed -n 370,400p $f | cut -c1-250; sed -n 470,500p $f | cut -c1-260; rg -n 'export (type|interface) (LogoProps|AsideHeaderItem)' -A 30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -80
f=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; sed -n 1,84p $f; sed -n 259,348p $f; sed -n 453,600p $f
d=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/docs; ls -R $d; sed -n 1,200p $d/INDEX.md | rg -v '^\s*$' | head -90; sed -n 891,917p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table; cat $p/package.json | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print(d.get('exports'));print(d.get('sideEffects'))"; sed -n 597,730p $p/README.md; ls $p/build/esm; ls $p/build/esm/components $p/build/esm/hooks

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $p/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts $p/hooks/useTable.d.ts; cat $p/components/Table/Table.d.ts; rg -n 'getGroupTitle|stickyHeader|className|rowClassName|emptyContent|size\??:' $p/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts $p/components/Table/*.d.ts | head -40; rg -n 'selectionColumn' $p/constants/*.d.ts; rg -n "enableColumnReordering|interface ColumnMeta|declare module" -r '$0' $p --glob '*.d.ts' | head; rg -n 'import .*\.css' $p/components/Table/Table.js $p/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js $p/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.js | head; node -e "const p=require('./node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,1),p.sideEffects)"

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $p/types/base.d.ts | head -60; cat $p/components/Table/types.d.ts; cat $p/constants/selectionColumn.js; cat $p/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts; rg -n 'getGroupTitle|renderGroupHeader|isGroup' $p/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts $p/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js $p/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n 1,60p $p/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | rg -n 'GroupHeader|getIsGroupHeaderRow|getIsCustomRow' ; cat $p/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js; sed -n 25,110p $p/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts; rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow|shouldRenderGroupHeader' $p/utils/*.js $p/components/BaseRow/*.js | head

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; sed -n 1,40p $p/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts; rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' -A4 $p/components/BaseRow/*.js $p/components/BaseRow/*/*.js 2>/dev/null | rg -v '^\s*$' | head -30; ls $p/components/BaseRow
sed -n 18,80p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseRow/utils/getRowContent.js | rg -n 'GroupHeader|getIsGroupHeaderRow|getIsCustomRow|subRows|depth'

rg -n 'getIsGroupHeaderRow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/utils/*.js | head; rg -n 'export' node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/utils/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | cut -c1-200 | head -60

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $p/hooks/useTable.js | head -30; cat $p/components/BaseCell/BaseCell.d.ts | head -30; cat $p/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/ColumnReorderingProvider.d.ts 2>/dev/null || ls $p/components/ColumnReorderingProvider; cat $p/hooks/useRowVirtualizer.d.ts

p=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm; cat $p/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js; cat $p/components/ColumnReorderingProvider/types.d.ts; cat $p/components/TreeExpandableCell/TreeExpandableCell.d.ts

.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Label Checkbox Switch Button Text Flex 2>&1 | head -40; u=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components; rg -n 'theme\?|size\?|interactive|value\?' $u/Label/Label.d.ts | head; rg -n 'export type CheckboxProps|indeterminate|checked|onUpdate|size\?' $u/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts $u/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "TextInput" -l $u/controls/TextInput/*.d.ts | head -2; rg -n 'hasClear|startContent|onUpdate|placeholder' $u/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts | head

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Checkbox Switch 2>&1 | head -30; u=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $u/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts | head -20; rg -n 'indeterminate|checked|onUpdate|onChange|content' $u/hooks/private/useCheckbox/*.d.ts $u/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -20

t=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components; rg -n 'selected|--gt-table-[a-z-]+' -o $t/Table/Table.css $t/BaseTable/BaseTable.css $t/BaseRow/*.css 2>/dev/null | sort -u | head -40; rg -n 'import ".*css"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.js; rg -n 'export \* |export \{' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts | cut -c1-160 | head

t=node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components; ls $t/Table $t/BaseTable; head -c 1500 $t/Table/Table.css; echo; rg -o 'selected[^{]*' $t/Table/Table.css $t/BaseTable/BaseTable.css | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader | head; rg -l '\.css' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/*.js | head -3

sed -n 215,258p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/README.md; rg -n 'export interface ControlProps' -A 25 node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | rg 'checked|indeterminate|onUpdate|disabled'

f=src/orders/OrdersTable.tsx && sed -i "s/import type {ColumnDef, ColumnReorderingProviderProps} from '@gravity-ui\/table';/import type {BaseTableProps, ColumnDef, ColumnReorderingProviderProps} from '@gravity-ui\/table';/; s/NonNullable<React.ComponentProps<typeof Table<OrderRow>>\['renderGroupHeaderRowContent'\]>/NonNullable<BaseTableProps<OrderRow>['renderGroupHeaderRowContent']>/" $f && rg -n 'BaseTableProps' $f
npx tsc --noEmit -p . 2>&1 | head -40
rg -n 'pinned' -A3 node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/BaseTable/BaseTable.css node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/Table/Table.css | head -30
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15
rm -rf dist && git status --short && sed -n 9,22p package.json
npm uninstall @dnd-kit/utilities 2>&1 | tail -1 && npm install @gravity-ui/icons 2>&1 | tail -1 && npm ls @gravity-ui/icons @dnd-kit/sortable | head && npx tsc --noEmit -p . && echo TSC_OK
